summary: APPROVED for pre-data statistical implementation readiness. Every blocker from PH22B-REVIEW-016 is resolved without changing frozen scientific semantics or protected authority. The score diagnostic, compressed bootstrap, pair-day estimands, numerical preflight/fallback, certified decisions, exact equivalence fixture, complete two-pass performance projection, replay, hashes, and state binding are fit for independently QA-reviewed 2019-2021 development execution.

prior_blocker_disposition.evidence: Certified boundary contact now distinguishes true straddles from one-sided touch and applies the frozen inclusive/exclusive rule. Tests cover [-1,0] for H_RAW >=0, [3,4] for H_NORM <4, [4,5] for H_NORM <4, degenerate equality, and inclusive point thresholds.

The exact workload inventory records two deterministic replay passes, 24 named regression populations with verified K dimensions, and five non-regression populations. The measured projection is 15458.109976300339 seconds versus the frozen 43200-second limit.

statistical_verification.score_diagnostic: PASS: restricted M4 and auxiliary exposure residualization use frozen pair-day WLS weights, UTC-day CR1 scores, chi-square(1), two-sided p-value, and supporting-only non-gating provenance.
statistical_verification.compressed_bootstrap: PASS: exact year-stratified PCG64(22002) schedules, 10000 replicates, day multiplicities, logical N/G, source-day CR1 meat, stable ordering, and response-specific complete-case populations are retained.
statistical_verification.fallback: PASS: path choice and fallback invalidity are matrix-only preflight decisions; SPD and stacked QR/SVD paths use frozen rank/condition/envelope rules, SVD bread, source-day CR1 meat, and the bounded 100/10000 fallback cap.
statistical_verification.derived_statistics: PASS: coefficient/contrast, attenuation, direct pair-day, normalization ratio, quantile, p-value, and scientific-boundary decisions use certified intervals and fail closed only for unresolved straddles or denominator-zero conditions.
statistical_verification.pair_day_estimand: PASS: each eligible pair/day contributes equally within each year and each year contributes equally, matching the expanded reference under unequal pair availability.
statistical_verification.multiplicity_and_fdr: PASS: frozen raw p-value numerator conventions and Benjamini-Hochberg families remain unchanged; the replacement score test is excluded.
statistical_verification.equivalence: PASS: fixed 10000-draw expanded/compressed synthetic distribution fixture matches replicate values within the frozen numerical acceptance and reproduces p-value counts and percentile endpoints.
statistical_verification.performance: PASS: exact K-specific inventory and two production replay passes project to 15458.109976300339 seconds; benchmark wall time 1082.371652300004 seconds and peak additional RSS 450580480 bytes satisfy frozen limits.
statistical_verification.reproducibility: PASS: canonical specification, benchmark, and little-endian int64 schedule hashes reproduce; production replay contract remains byte-identical.
statistical_verification.authority: PASS: no-data control plane binds v12 and only 2019-2021; 2022/2023 remain locked and 2024+ forbidden.

limitations: This approval is implementation-readiness evidence only and does not itself authorize data access, advance the phase, or approve any scientific result.
Independent QA approval and Project Orchestrator gate recording remain required before 2019-2021 execution.
